# Anchors restricted to deterministic-known symbols with file fallback

When building fact anchors, the extractor filters LLM-provided symbol_paths to those present in known_symbols for the file; if no valid symbol anchors remain, it falls back to a file-level Anchor.

Prevent the LLM from inventing symbol-level anchors and ensure every fact has at least file-level evidence.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/extractors/llm_extractor.py` — `knowledge_compiler.extractors.llm_extractor.LLMSemanticExtractor._to_facts`
